products.name: Ashcroft Linen-Cotton Shirt
products.description: A button-down shirt in a linen-cotton blend that breathes like linen but creases far less. The rose shade is piece-dyed, so it reads soft rather than flat, and settles a half-tone lighter after the first few washes. A rolled button-down collar holds its shape unironed, and the single chest pocket is sized for a phone. Cut straight through the body to wear tucked or loose.

products.name: Aster Denim Coach Jacket
products.description: Built around an oversized silhouette that softens with wear, the Aster is our take on the classic coach jacket. The body is cut from a 12oz rigid denim woven in Okayama, Japan, with a deep indigo rinse that fades gradually and personally over time. Antique-silver tack buttons run the front placket, and side-seam pockets sit deep enough to actually use. Unlined and breathable, it works open over a shirt in spring or layered under a coat when the weather turns.

products.name: Bramley Wool Crewneck
products.description: A crewneck knit from lambswool spun with a light halo, so the surface stays soft-focus rather than crisp. The oat shade is a melange of undyed and lightly dyed fibres, which keeps it warm instead of grey. Ribbing at the neck, cuffs and hem is knit slightly tighter than the body to hold shape. Roomy through the chest with a gently dropped shoulder.

products.name: Corbin Pleated Short

The cotton is a dry-handle twill that holds a press but relaxes over a day of wear. Undyed ecru, so it warms slightly with age.

products.name: Foundry Cotton Overshirt
products.description: A workwear overshirt cut heavy enough to wear as a light jacket. The cloth is a dense cotton twill, garment-dyed in small lots so the olive shifts slightly from piece to piece and keeps shifting as it wears. Two flap chest pockets sit high and square, and the hem is straight so it sits cleanly over a tee. Roomy through the body with a dropped shoulder, it layers over knitwear without pulling.

products.name: Halden Waffle Henley
products.description: A long-sleeve henley knit in a heavy cotton waffle that holds its texture through repeated washing. The three-button placket is cut short and finished with a flat rib so it lies clean under a jacket. Ribbed cuffs grip at the wrist without cutting in. It is substantial enough to wear alone in autumn and thin enough to layer under a coach jacket.

products.name: Lucca Sleeveless Dress
products.description: A sleeveless column dress that skims rather than clings. The cotton-linen cloth has enough body to hold the line of the skirt and enough give to move easily. A high round neck and a narrow armhole keep the shoulder covered, and the side seams are split at the hem so it walks properly. Fully opaque in ivory, with no lining needed.

products.name: Meridian Wide-Leg Trouser
products.description: A pleated wide-leg trouser cut from a soft indigo denim that drapes rather than holds a shape. The denim is washed once before construction, so the fit you try on is the fit you keep.

products.name: Sorrel Linen Camp Shirt
products.description: An open-collar shirt in undyed European linen, left its natural colour so the slubs and flecks in the yarn stay visible. The camp collar sits flat and open without a stand, and the body is cut generously so air moves through it. It creases, and it is supposed to — the cloth softens with every wash and stops fighting you after about three.

products.name: Wren Washed Cap
products.description: A six-panel cap in washed cotton twill, softened before it ever reaches you so the crown sits low instead of standing up. The brim is pre-curved and stays where you bend it. An antique-brass buckle strap adjusts at the back rather than a plastic snap. The black has been overdyed and washed back, so it reads closer to a deep charcoal in daylight.
